title: SDK: Unified Embeddings & Rerank API parity + pagination/batching helpers across Python/TS/Go
creator: Ava Patel
description:
Background: Several customers and internal teams requested consistent SDK ergonomics for embeddings and reranking endpoints across languages. Current gaps: Python SDK exposes a helper for batching embeddings but TypeScript/Go lack equivalent helpers and pagination semantics differ between SDKs. Reranking endpoint usage patterns (score normalization, top-k pagination) are inconsistently implemented across samples.

Goals:
- Deliver API parity for embeddings and reranking features in Python, TypeScript, and Go SDKs (stable public methods and parameter names).
- Add pagination and batching helpers that are idiomatic per language but share the same semantics (cursor-based pagination for rerank, chunk/batch helpers for embeddings).
- Provide streaming-friendly ergonomics for rerank scoring pipelines and retries/timeout defaults aligned across SDKs.
- Ship examples and migration notes for customers and update docs/quickstarts.

Scope:
- Public SDK surface only (no runtime changes). Backward-compatible defaults required.
- Implement: Embeddings.batch_from_iterable helper, Embeddings.paginate_embeddings (cursorless batch iterator), Rerank.paginate_top_k(cursor-based), unified RetryPolicy config surface, streaming-friendly tokenized rerank iterator for long documents.
- Languages: python, typescript (node), go.

Non-goals:
- No changes to server-side endpoints. Quantization/throughput optimizations handled separately.

Design Summary:
- API contracts: keep high-level method names identical where possible: embeddings.batch, embeddings.stream_batches, rerank.top_k_paginate.
- Pagination: use opaque cursors returned by API; SDK helper exposes generator/iterator semantics (Python: iterator, TS: AsyncIterable, Go: channel-style iterator).
- Batching: Provide convenience to take any iterable/slice of inputs and produce appropriately sized requests based on SDK-configured max_tokens_per_request and max_items_per_request.
- Retries: Expose a RetryPolicy class/struct across SDKs with fields: max_attempts, backoff_base_ms, max_backoff_ms, retryable_statuses. Default values tuned to inference load patterns.

Acceptance criteria: see acceptance_criteria field.
acceptance_criteria: All three SDKs (python/typescript/go) expose equivalent public methods for embeddings batching and rerank pagination with matching parameter names where idiomatic
Unit tests for batching helpers covering size boundaries, empty inputs, and max_item limits
Integration test (recorded) against staging Redwood API validating cursor-based pagination for rerank and idempotency across retries
Examples/README updated in each SDK repo with one-liner quickstart and longer example showing embeddings -> rerank pipeline
Telemetry events emitted for helper usage (batch_size, pagination_pages, retry_count) with schema agreed in docs
No breaking changes to existing public methods; migration notes published for any deprecated aliases
